The '''Reflection of the Essential Infinities''' was a chamber inside the ''[[Teljkon Vagabond]]''. If all beings inside the chamber grabbed a handhold from the wall, the chamber would turn dark. Using a shadow-box mechanism, the chamber would then show a 3d picture of [[Brath Qella]], its [[Moon/Legends|moons]], and its [[Star/Legends|star]], [[N'oka Brath]]. The room updates to show Brath Qella, its moons, and its stars when it regenerates.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />
